Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mini RFP: Observability archival pilot (Datadog / Grafana / Sentry scope)

Hi all,

We are planning a small, time-boxed pilot to evaluate archival / long-term retention options across our observability stack for the NimbusRetail account. Goal: quantify unit egress/storage costs, query performance against cold/nearline buckets, and SSO/audit integration complexity.

Attached is a short pilot scope (pilot-scope.xlsx) — please review. High level ask: provide a short written RFI response covering the items in the sheet and an indicative pilot pricing proposal. We want to run the pilot in July (3-4 weeks).

Key constraints / success metrics:
- Max spend for pilot: $7k (all-in)
- Retention target to evaluate: 90d + long-term hot/cold split options
- Query SLA for day-0 cold queries: <10s 95th for sample workloads
- Integration: SSO + audit logs to our SIEM (we use Splunk)

Please confirm by EOD Friday 5/29 whether you can take part and who will be the technical lead. If you need a short call to clarify scope, propose times and we’ll schedule.

Attachments: pilot-scope.xlsx (xlsx, 13KB)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

- Loop in CS for NimbusRetail (they own the account exec). Marissa, can you add the AM?

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the scope — SentinelOps can participate. I attached a short RFI response (rfi-responses.pdf) that maps our capabilities to each pilot item and an initial, non-binding pilot estimate. A few clarifying Qs: 

1) For archive queries you list sample workloads — can Marcus share the query mix Lauren requested (percent aggregation vs raw search)?
2) Are you open to a hybrid pilot where we host a cold copy on S3 behind our index and you proxy queries? That would reduce egress for the pilot.
3) For SSO: we support SAML and OIDC. Do you prefer the app be federated into your IdP or a separate service account?

We can do a 30-min call Tue 6/2 09:00-11:00 PT if that works.

Attachments: rfi-responses.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

Best,
Ingrid Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | SentinelOps

Forwarding Ingrid's note — sales + partnerships, please note NimbusRetail is price sensitive and expects clear all-in pilot caps. Jonas set $7k as our internal cap. For vendors: you should include any egress credits or S3 costs in the proposal line items so we can compare apples-to-apples.

In addition: if Datadog / Grafana / Sentry want to co-run a single pilot (multi-vendor), we need a clear definition of ownership for data and a single point of contact. That option is not preferred but worth noting if it reduces duplication.
